name: Balancer Protocol
fix_description: Use balance-before/balance-after pattern to determine actual received token amount instead of trusting tokenAmountIn directly. Update inRecord.balance with the actual received amount to prevent divergence when fee-on-transfer tokens are involved.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit requires deep Balancer-specific understanding of boosted pool virtual supply, cached rate updates, and a non-obvious precision-loss issue, combined with a carefully ordered multi-step attack chain using flash loan funding, pool draining, batch swaps, cache manipulation, profit extraction, and repayment. Even though the PoC is not extremely long, the vulnerability itself is highly protocol-specific and would likely take an experienced auditor more than 2 hours to derive from code and reproduce confidently.
